description: Everything on the connected user's plate right now ("what's on my plate?", "what should I do today?"). One merged list, exactly what the app's My-tasks page shows: tickets assigned to them or their teams, orders they should fulfill, stocktaking rooms to count, low-stock restock signals, maintenance-run batches (one row per plan with openCount) and pending setup handovers. section "mine" = theirs to act on; section "team" = a teammate took team work over (holder says who). In section "mine" the maintenance row REPLACES the plan's individual run tickets: they are not in this list, because the plan is what a person acts on, and the per-check rows behind openCount are not returned. In section "team", run tickets a teammate took over stay individual rows, because the holder is per ticket. Rows carry the ids follow-up calls take (ticketId, orderId, planId, sessionId, ...) and a title where the task has one. Dates come twice, epoch and ISO twin: `dueAtIso` is a plain calendar day, `sinceIso` the UTC instant the work started waiting (`sinceMs` is a moment, not a duration); the server does no timezone conversion. An empty list means nothing is on their plate.
name: my_tasks

tasks.description: The connected user's to-do rows. Each row also carries its own payload ids (ticketId, orderId, itemId, …) for follow-up calls.

dueAtIso.description: The due date as a plain calendar day, "YYYY-MM-DD"; a day, not a moment, so no timezone applies

holder.description: Who took it over, for team rows

section.description: "mine" = act on it; "team" = a teammate took it over

sinceIso.description: The same moment as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — read THIS one; the server does no timezone conversion

sinceMs.description: When this started waiting for the connected user, epoch milliseconds. A MOMENT despite the name, not a duration

source.description: What generated the task (ticket, order, restock, setup, …)

title.description: Task title, when it has one

viaTeamName.description: Team that routed it to the connected user

title: My tasks
